summary: Iteration 124 - Displacement Analysis, LOS Optimizer, and Mobile Companion features fully tested. All 15 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all components loading correctly, forms working, and data displaying properly.

endpoints: POST /api/revenue/displacement/analyze - Returns recommendation (ACCEPT/REJECT/NEUTRAL), confidence, group vs individual revenue comparison, displacement cost, daily analysis, risk factors
features: Group booking analysis with rooms, rate, dates
Group revenue vs expected individual revenue comparison
Displacement cost calculation (positive = lost revenue, negative = extra revenue)
Daily breakdown with demand scores and fill probability
Risk factors (low_demand, high_demand, capacity, long_stay, deep_discount)

endpoints: GET /api/revenue/los-optimizer/{property_id} - Returns LOS distribution, DOW analysis, source analysis, recommendations
features: DOW (Day of Week) check-in analysis with avg LOS per day
Source analysis (Expedia, Walk-in, Affiliate, etc.) with avg LOS
Recommendations: min_stay, extended_discount, weekend_package, rate_ladder, gap_filler
LOS restriction creation with type, value, days, date range

endpoints: GET /api/mobile/dashboard/{property_id} - Today's KPIs, tomorrow preview, action items
GET /api/mobile/arrivals/{property_id} - Today's arrival list with guest details
features: Today's KPIs: occupancy %, booked/total rooms, revenue, ADR, arrivals, departures, in_house
Action items: dirty_rooms, pending_reviews, price_alerts, unread_notifications
Arrivals list with guest name, room type, nights, status, source, registration status
Housekeeping breakdown: clean/dirty/inspected counts with room details

features_verified: Input form with group name, check-in, check-out, rooms, rate
Run Displacement Analysis button
Result card with ACCEPT/REJECT/NEUTRAL badge and confidence
Group Booking vs Expected Individual Revenue comparison
Net Displacement Cost display (green for extra revenue, red for lost)
Decision buttons: Accept Group, Reject Group, Negotiate Rate
Risk factors section with impact indicators
KPIs: Avg LOS, Avg Rate/Night, Total Bookings, Recommendations count
Recommendations with priority badges (high/medium/low)
Stay Length Distribution bar chart
Check-in Day Analysis table (Mon-Sun)
LOS by Booking Source table
Mobile-optimized layout centered on screen
3 tabs: Today, Arrivals (count), HK (dirty count)
Today tab: Occupancy %, Revenue, Arrivals, Departures KPIs
Action items: dirty rooms, price alerts, notifications
Tomorrow preview with occupancy and arrivals
Arrivals tab: Guest list with Check In buttons
Housekeeping tab: Clean/Dirty/Inspected counts, Rooms to Clean list with Mark Clean buttons
Revenue sidebar: rev-tab-displacement and rev-tab-los-optimizer in Intelligence section
Main sidebar: mobile-companion-btn navigates to Mobile View

critical_code_review_comments: Displacement analysis correctly compares group revenue vs expected individual revenue based on historical booking rates and demand fill probability
LOS optimizer generates actionable recommendations (min-stay, extended discount, rate ladder, gap filler) based on booking patterns
Mobile companion provides quick access to daily KPIs and action items optimized for mobile screens
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
All endpoints properly protected with role-based authentication (admin, manager, receptionist for mobile)
